description: This file defines a Fragment for an Android application that displays a list of products in a scrollable RecyclerView. It manages the UI components, handles user interaction for searching and selecting products, and communicates with a ViewModel to fetch and filter products. It also includes internal classes for the RecyclerView adapter and view holder.

classes.name: ProductListFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of products, enables search filtering, and handles navigation to product details.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for rendering a list of Product items.

classes.name: ProductViewHolder
classes.description: RecyclerView ViewHolder binding Product data to item views.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components, observers, and event handlers.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ProductListFragment.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with a new list of products.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Product object to the view holder's UI elements.
